result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility issue: interactive favorite (heart) buttons lack accessible labels, making their function unclear for assistive technology users and visually impaired users.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons for restaurant items (Tokumaru Ramen Bar and the partially visible pizza restaurant below) have no visible text or accessible screen-reader labels. This makes the buttons' purpose unknown to visually impaired users relying on screen readers, and their function is not clearly communicated to all users.
issues.suggestion: Add descriptive accessible labels (e.g., aria-label attributes like 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites' and 'Add this pizza restaurant to favorites') to these buttons, and optionally add a tooltip or visible text to clarify their function for all users.
